description:
[FREE] Live swap quote from the Super Intelligence Exchange (siexchange.lol).
Non-custodial, 5 chains: solana, base, ethereum, polygon, robinhood.
Launch-set coins trade FREE: MUSKOX (Solana); ARENA, SOLV, AGWC, GITLAWB (Base);
GITLAWB also on Robinhood Chain. Any other token costs $0.02 USDC via x402 per trade (use
siexchange_calldata for execution). token_in/token_out accept symbols
(ETH, USDC, SOL, MUSKOX, ARENA, SOLV, AGWC, GITLAWB) or contract addresses.
amount_in is raw integer units (e.g. 100000000000000 = 0.0001 ETH,
100000000 = 0.1 SOL). Returns amountIn, amountOut, minAmountOut, tier (free|paid),
venue, priceImpactBps, warnings and chainId. EVM chains also return hops (the swap
path; no route field), approvals, blockNumber and deadline. Solana quotes return
route (e.g. moonshot-constant-product-v1) instead of hops, and carry no
blockNumber, approvals or deadline. Quotes cost nothing.
name: siexchange_quote
